a judgement, not a measured miss, and the one row in this file to argue with. NCT04579380 (SGNTUC-019) cohort 2, uterine cancer with HER2 amplification or overexpression, posted a confirmed objective response rate of 13.3% (95% CI 4.7 to 28.0) by investigator. That is a signal rather than nothing, and I have no sourced threshold to say it is too low. What carries the row to nil is therefore not the response rate but the silence around it: primary completion was 2023-11-01, no registrational uterine study has followed in the three years since, and Pfizer's Q1 2026 Pipeline Update (5 May 2026) carries no tucatinib uterine programme at any phase. Silence is weaker evidence than a stated miss, which is why this is a judgement
